name: Unusually Large Transfer
description: A single transaction whose amount is more than 5x the customer's own median transaction amount, or exceeds ₹200,000, whichever is lower as a trigger threshold.

name: Burst of Payments to a Newly Added Payee
description: 3 or more transactions to the same payee within a 72-hour window, where that payee had no transaction history with this customer in the 60 days prior to the first payment in the burst.

name: Odd-Hours Activity
description: A transaction timestamped between 00:00 and 05:00 local time, for a customer whose transaction history shows fewer than 5% of activity historically occurring in that window.

name: Break From Established Pattern
description: A transaction whose category, channel, or geography is not present anywhere in the customer's prior 90-day history, combined with an amount above the customer's 75th percentile spend.
logic: category_or_channel_or_geo NOT IN customer_90d_history AND amount > p75(customer_amounts)

name: Rapid Sequential Drain
description: 3 or more outgoing transactions within a 24-hour window that cumulatively exceed 60% of the customer's average monthly outflow.
